INA226 36V, 16-Bit, Ultra-Precise I2C Output Current, Voltage, and Power Monitor With
                                         Alert
1 Features                                                               3 Description
•    Senses bus voltages from 0V to 36V                                  The INA226 is a current shunt and power monitor
•    High-side or low-side sensing                                       with an I2C™- or SMBUS-compatible interface. The
•    Reports current, voltage, and power                                 device monitors both a shunt voltage drop and
•    High accuracy:                                                      bus supply voltage. Programmable calibration value,
     – Gain error: 0.1% (maximum)                                        conversion times, and averaging, combined with an
     – Offset: 10μV (maximum)                                            internal multiplier, enable direct readouts of current in
•    Configurable averaging options                                      amperes and power in watts.
•    16 programmable addresses                                           The INA226 senses current on common-mode bus
•    Operates from 2.7V to 5.5V power supply                             voltages that can vary from 0V to 36V, independent
•    10-pin DGS (VSSOP) package                                          of the supply voltage. The device operates from
2 Applications                                                           a single 2.7V to 5.5V supply, drawing a typical of
                                                                         330μA of supply current. The device is specified
•    Rack servers                                                        over the operating temperature range between –40°C
•    Wireless infrastructure                                             and 125°C and features up to 16 programmable
•    High performance computing                                          addresses on the I2C-compatible interface.
•    Power management
•    Battery cell monitors and balancers                                                     Package Information
•    Power Supplies                                                            PART NUMBER           PACKAGE(1)               PACKAGE SIZE(2)
•    Test Equipment                                                      INA226                 DGS (VSSOP, 10)           3.00mm × 4.90mm
